identification: French-style Art Deco figural mantel clock c.1930: reclining woman in cloche hood and long-sleeved robe (cold-painted bronzed spelter by appearance, with ivorine or ivory-look face and hands), facing a bronzed-spelter doe and fawn; scalloped quatrefoil onyx dial surround with brass Arabic chapter ring and two winding holes (8-day striking), on stepped black slate and banded onyx base, L79 H32 cm. Attributed in the catalogue to 'George Maxim' (Georges Maxim); no signature visible in any photo. It is the same clock as Armitage sale 28975 lot 809 (closed 11 Nov 2026, then estimate A$1,500-2,000, hammer A$850 per database): photos here still carry the '809' lot tag and the page photos match. Now estimate A$1,300-1,600.

viewing_check: Look under the figure base and on the onyx for a Maxim signature; magnet/scratch test underside of the figure (spelter is grey, bronze is brass-coloured); check face and hands for ivory grain vs ivorine; chips on onyx corners and dial surround; ask for the key and test that it runs and strikes.
